notes: ruling asked: «حدثنا صاحب، هذه الدار وأشار إلى دار عبد الله» names no one: «صاحب» is the owner of the house and the text points to Abdullah's house; «قال سألت رسول الله» is either said by «صاحب» or by Abdullah, and the text does not say which (rule 6 leaves Abdullah out)
«عبد الله» is written only as the place (rule 6); the last link is kept at «صاحب» and not completed
